title: Stedmans upper Main St
description: This photograph captures a bustling Main Street in July 1960, featuring the Stedmans 5&10 Store, Handy Andy, the Post Office, and the Capitol Theatre on the west side. On the left, you can spot David Howell’s pool hall and Roy Stevens’ barber shop at street level, with Howell’s residence above. Today, only the former federal post office building remains, now home to the Dr. Walter Chestnut Library. (Photo courtesy of Hoot Smith)
